description: Use this when the user wants packing slips ("packing slip template", "print packing slips", "etsy packing slip 4x6", "shopify packing slip", "packing slip generator") for their orders. First convert pasted text or an image of orders into order objects (order_number, ship_to, items with sku, name, qty, gift_message), or pass the attached Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce or Amazon order export. Makes a PDF with one packing slip per order (order number, date, ship-to, items with SKU, quantity and a tick box, notes, gift message) on US Letter, A4 or a 4x6 label, prices hidden unless show_prices, plus a pick list PDF totalled by SKU and CSVs. Long orders continue on a second page; each line is printed and problems are listed. Does not buy postage, print shipping labels or barcodes, or change orders in the store.

columns.description: Column mapping when headings are unusual, field to heading, e.g. {"order":"Ref","qty":"Pcs","sku":"Code"}. Fields: order, date, name, address1, address2, city, state, zip, country, item, variant, sku, qty, price, notes, gift, method, location.

file.description: Optional order export: CSV, TSV or Excel .xlsx from Shopify (Orders export), Etsy (Order Items), WooCommerce or Amazon (unshipped orders report), or any sheet with order, ship-to, SKU, item and quantity columns, e.g. orders_export.csv.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

country.description: Country for orders abroad, e.g. Canada.

from_address.description: Your return address printed next to the ship-to, e.g. "Maple & Clay\n42 Oak Lane\nPortland, OR 97205".

home_country.description: Country you ship from; the country line prints only for orders abroad. Default: from_address's country, else United States.

message.description: Thank-you line printed at the bottom of each slip, e.g. Thank you for your order.

currency.description: Currency code for prices, e.g. USD.

gift_message.description: Gift message printed in a box, e.g. Happy birthday, love Sam.

location.description: Bin or shelf for the pick list, e.g. A-03.

name.description: Item name, e.g. Blue ceramic mug.

price.description: Unit price, e.g. 12.50, only printed with show_prices.

sku.description: SKU or product code, e.g. MUG-BL-12.

variant.description: Variant or options, e.g. Size: M, Color: Blue.

items.description: Line items, e.g. [{"sku":"MUG-BL","name":"Blue mug","qty":2}] or ["2 x Blue mug (SKU MUG-BL)"].

notes.description: Customer note printed in a box, e.g. Please leave at the back door.

order_date.description: Order date as shown to the customer, e.g. 2026-10-20.

country.description: Country for orders abroad, e.g. Canada.

ship_to.description: Ship-to address as an object, or text with lines separated by \n.

shipping_method.description: Shipping method, e.g. USPS Ground Advantage.

orders.description: The orders, one slip each. Convert what the user pasted or showed in an image into order objects first, e.g. [{"order_number":"1001","ship_to":{"name":"Jane Smith","address1":"123 Main St","city":"Springfield","state":"IL","zip":"62704"},"items":[{"sku":"MUG-BL","name":"Blue mug","qty":2}],"gift_message":"Happy birthday"}]. Pasted export CSV text with its header row also works.

page_size.description: letter (default, one order per page), a4, or 4x6 for a 4 x 6 in thermal label.

sheet.description: Excel sheet to read, e.g. Orders.

show_prices.description: Print unit prices, line totals and an items subtotal, e.g. true. Default false (gift-friendly slips).

sort.description: Order of the slips: none (as given, default), order_number or name.

store_name.description: Store name printed at the top of each slip, e.g. Maple & Clay Studio.

uppercase.description: Ship-to address in capitals without punctuation (USPS style). Default false.
